ne331e5425e.headline: Ministry of Commerce of China: Thanks to the huge consumer market, China ranks first in the world in retail online sales volume
ne331e5425e.summary: China's domestic trade turnover has rapidly increased over the past five years, making it the world leader in retail online sales volume, according to the Ministry of Commerce of China.
ne331e5425e.why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a major driver of global consumption and trade, making its retail and e-commerce trends important for investors worldwide.
ne331e5425e.why_moved: China's rapid growth in online retail sales signals strong domestic consumption, influencing global trade and investor sentiment.

n8b343f3cb6.headline: Buhari signs 2021 Budget
n8b343f3cb6.summary: President Muhammadu Buhari signed the 2021 Appropriation Act and the 2021 Finance Act into law at the presidential villa in Abuja, following National Assembly approval.
n8b343f3cb6.why: The budget and finance acts set Nigeria's fiscal framework for 2021, impacting government spending, taxation, and economic policy.

n7a1d614ec2.headline: Europe: Stocks retreat in thin trading, set to end 2020 with losses
n7a1d614ec2.summary: European equities declined on the last trading day of 2020 amid thin volumes and renewed coronavirus lockdowns in Britain.
n7a1d614ec2.why: European stock markets reflect investor sentiment on economic recovery and pandemic-related restrictions, impacting global markets.
n7a1d614ec2.why_moved: Renewed lockdowns and year-end position adjustments led investors to reduce risk exposure, causing European stocks to retreat.

nf44001ad52.headline: Nordica signed a contract with LOT to acquire the entire stake in Xfly
nf44001ad52.summary: Nordic Aviation Group (Nordica) agreed to buy LOT's 49% stake in joint subsidiary Xfly, becoming its sole owner after long negotiations.
nf44001ad52.why: Nordica and LOT are key players in the European regional airline market; ownership changes affect strategic control and operational decisions.
